exposure: UGT1A1 c.211 G > A mutation (UGT1A1*6, p.Arg71Gly, rs4148323)
heterozygous and/or homozygous UGT1A1 mutations in the coding sequence region
cohort: Sixty-nine ABO hemolysis neonates (ABO HDN) admitted to a large general hospital in southern China from 2011 to 2017, who were referred for neonatal hyperbilirubinemia.
finding: The UGT1A1 c.211 G > A mutation and other heterozygous/homozygous UGT1A1 mutations in the coding region were significantly associated with increased bilirubin levels and an elevated risk of hazardous hyperbilirubinemia in ABO HDNs.
